entries.definition_short: Strict freshness-governed control for import acceptance, receipt anchoring, watermark advancement, restoration eligibility, quarantine, and readmission.
entries.definition_operational: The agent governs strictly increasing freshness acceptance across sources and devices. It evaluates imports, anchors accepted receipts, advances the acceptance watermark, and controls restoration eligibility without directly executing restore or tool activation.
source_refs: Freshness Portability Agent — Specification §1 Normative Status and Scope
Freshness Portability Agent — Specification §2 Agent Overview
usage_constraints: Tool activation and direct restore execution remain outside the agent's authority.

entries.definition_short: The strictly increasing freshness condition is satisfied.
entries.definition_operational: State token S3. Allowed outbound transitions: `IRRAppended -> S4`

entries.definition_short: The case is suspended pending new evidence, a new policy basis, or operator review.

entries.definition_short: All constitutive conditions pass and the agent may emit APPEND_IRR.
entries.definition_operational: Gate class = RELEASE. Acceptance becomes effective only through the receipt path declared in the specification.

entries.definition_short: Operational action that requests durable receipt append for an accepted import.
entries.definition_operational: This action is part of the operational action set and is emitted only on the gate paths that authorize APPEND_IRR.
source_refs: Freshness Portability Agent — Specification §13 Gate Logic
Freshness Portability Agent — Specification §6 Decision Table

entries.definition_short: Gate class that supports REJECT and FAIL_CLOSED.
entries.definition_operational: The permitted blocking actions are REJECT_STALE, REJECT_INVALID, DENY_RESTORE, and BLOCK_TOOL_STATE, with no downstream restorative mutation.
source_refs: Freshness Portability Agent — Specification §13 Gate Logic

entries.definition_short: Operational action that blocks tool-state activation outside agent authority.
entries.definition_operational: This action is part of the operational action set and is emitted only on the gate paths that authorize BLOCK_TOOL_STATE.
source_refs: Freshness Portability Agent — Specification §13 Gate Logic
Freshness Portability Agent — Specification §6 Decision Table

entries.definition_short: Operational action that blocks restore admission on the restore path.
entries.definition_operational: This action is part of the operational action set and is emitted only on the gate paths that authorize DENY_RESTORE.
source_refs: Freshness Portability Agent — Specification §13 Gate Logic
Freshness Portability Agent — Specification §6 Decision Table

entries.definition_short: Gate class that supports QUARANTINE.
entries.definition_operational: The operational action is OPEN_QUARANTINE_CASE for operator or policy review.
source_refs: Freshness Portability Agent — Specification §13 Gate Logic

entries.definition_short: If the constitutive conditions are not fully satisfied, the effect is blocked.
entries.definition_operational: Concrete actions include REJECT_INVALID, DENY_RESTORE, and BLOCK_TOOL_STATE. Gate class = BLOCK.
source_refs: Freshness Portability Agent — Specification §14 Semantic Contract

entries.definition_short: Operational action that emits the restore admission token for a restore-eligible accepted head.
entries.definition_operational: This action is part of the operational action set and is emitted only on the gate paths that authorize ISSUE_RESTORE_ADMISSION_TOKEN.
source_refs: Freshness Portability Agent — Specification §13 Gate Logic
Freshness Portability Agent — Specification §6 Decision Table

entries.definition_short: Operational action that opens a suspended case for operator or policy review.
entries.definition_operational: This action is part of the operational action set and is emitted only on the gate paths that authorize OPEN_QUARANTINE_CASE.
source_refs: Freshness Portability Agent — Specification §13 Gate Logic
Freshness Portability Agent — Specification §6 Decision Table

entries.definition_short: The case is suspended because required evidence or policy support is missing, but the case may become re-evaluable.
entries.definition_operational: The concrete action is OPEN_QUARANTINE_CASE. Gate class = ESCALATION.
source_refs: Freshness Portability Agent — Specification §14 Semantic Contract
ambiguities: Semantic verdict; distinct from the state token QUARANTINED and from the record QuarantineCaseRecord.

entries.definition_short: A suspended case that may be re-evaluated only when new evidence or a new policy basis exists.
entries.definition_operational: The case remains suspended until new evidence or a new policy basis permits readmission review under the stated rules.
source_refs: Freshness Portability Agent — Specification §3 Core Terms and Public Definitions

entries.definition_short: Gate class that supports READMIT.
entries.definition_operational: The operational action is REENTER_VERIFIED, and the path is permitted only from QUARANTINED and only when new evidence or a new policy basis exists.
source_refs: Freshness Portability Agent — Specification §13 Gate Logic

entries.definition_short: A quarantined case re-enters evaluation from VERIFIED on the basis of normative novelty.
entries.definition_operational: The concrete action is REENTER_VERIFIED. Gate class = READMISSION.
source_refs: Freshness Portability Agent — Specification §14 Semantic Contract

entries.definition_short: Operational action that returns a quarantined case to VERIFIED for re-evaluation.
entries.definition_operational: This action is part of the operational action set and is emitted only on the gate paths that authorize REENTER_VERIFIED.
source_refs: Freshness Portability Agent — Specification §13 Gate Logic
Freshness Portability Agent — Specification §6 Decision Table

entries.definition_short: The constitutive conditions fail irrecoverably for the current packet.
entries.definition_operational: The concrete action is REJECT_STALE or REJECT_INVALID. Gate class = BLOCK.
source_refs: Freshness Portability Agent — Specification §14 Semantic Contract

entries.definition_short: Operational action that rejects an invalid packet or invalid binding with no downstream restorative effect.
entries.definition_operational: This action is part of the operational action set and is emitted only on the gate paths that authorize REJECT_INVALID.
source_refs: Freshness Portability Agent — Specification §13 Gate Logic
Freshness Portability Agent — Specification §6 Decision Table

entries.definition_short: Operational action that rejects a stale packet without receipt emission or watermark update.
entries.definition_operational: This action is part of the operational action set and is emitted only on the gate paths that authorize REJECT_STALE.
source_refs: Freshness Portability Agent — Specification §13 Gate Logic
Freshness Portability Agent — Specification §6 Decision Table

entries.definition_short: Gate class that supports ACCEPT and RESTORATION_ELIGIBLE.
entries.definition_operational: APPEND_IRR requires durable receipt append, and ISSUE_RESTORE_ADMISSION_TOKEN requires valid IRR linkage and GenesisConfirmed.
source_refs: Freshness Portability Agent — Specification §13 Gate Logic

entries.definition_short: The accepted head is semantically admitted to the restore service.
entries.definition_operational: The concrete action is ISSUE_RESTORE_ADMISSION_TOKEN. Gate class = RELEASE.
source_refs: Freshness Portability Agent — Specification §14 Semantic Contract
ambiguities: Semantic verdict; do not collapse with the state token S6 of the same label.

entries.definition_short: Decision object with condition set: Valid structure AND valid `SSM` AND valid `packet_hash` AND policy compatible AND `freshness_new > watermark[source_id]`
entries.definition_operational: When this decision object is evaluated, the semantic verdict is ACCEPT and the operational action is APPEND_IRR. Gate class = RELEASE. The watermark may advance only after durable receipt append.
source_refs: Freshness Portability Agent — Specification §6 Decision Table / DT-01

entries.definition_short: Decision object with condition set: Required evidence or required transport cannot be confirmed, but the case is recoverable through new evidence or a new policy basis
entries.definition_operational: When this decision object is evaluated, the semantic verdict is QUARANTINE and the operational action is OPEN_QUARANTINE_CASE. Gate class = ESCALATION. No receipt is emitted.
source_refs: Freshness Portability Agent — Specification §6 Decision Table / DT-04

entries.definition_short: Decision object with condition set: Open quarantine case AND (`new_evidence` OR `new_policy`) AND policy permits re-evaluation
entries.definition_operational: When this decision object is evaluated, the semantic verdict is READMIT and the operational action is REENTER_VERIFIED. Gate class = ESCALATION / READMISSION.
source_refs: Freshness Portability Agent — Specification §6 Decision Table / DT-07

entries.definition_short: Decision object with condition set: Invalid `SSM` OR invalid hash OR invalid structure/canonicalization
entries.definition_operational: When this decision object is evaluated, the semantic verdict is FAIL_CLOSED and the operational action is REJECT_INVALID. Gate class = BLOCK. No downstream restorative effect.
source_refs: Freshness Portability Agent — Specification §6 Decision Table / DT-03

entries.definition_short: Decision object with condition set: `freshness_new <= watermark[source_id]`
entries.definition_operational: When this decision object is evaluated, the semantic verdict is REJECT and the operational action is REJECT_STALE. Gate class = BLOCK. No receipt is emitted and the watermark is not updated.
source_refs: Freshness Portability Agent — Specification §6 Decision Table / DT-02

entries.definition_short: Decision object with condition set: Valid `IRR` AND linked `accepted_head_digest` AND `GenesisConfirmed`
entries.definition_operational: When this decision object is evaluated, the semantic verdict is RESTORATION_ELIGIBLE and the operational action is ISSUE_RESTORE_ADMISSION_TOKEN. Gate class = RELEASE to the restore service. Execution-neutral.
source_refs: Freshness Portability Agent — Specification §6 Decision Table / DT-05

entries.definition_short: Decision object with condition set: Missing `IRR` OR unlinked `accepted_head_digest` OR `GenesisConfirmed = false`
entries.definition_operational: When this decision object is evaluated, the semantic verdict is FAIL_CLOSED and the operational action is DENY_RESTORE. Gate class = BLOCK.
source_refs: Freshness Portability Agent — Specification §6 Decision Table / DT-06

entries.definition_short: Framing, length, checksum, and canonicalization.
entries.definition_operational: Input: TransferPacket. Guard / transition linkage: `StructureValid`; pass `S1 -> S2`; fail `S1 -> S8`.. Failure effect: `FAIL_CLOSED -> REJECT_INVALID`.
source_refs: Freshness Portability Agent — Specification §7 Validator Catalogue / VAL-001

entries.definition_short: Validates the `SSM` signature and packet-hash binding.
entries.definition_operational: Input: `SSM`. Guard / transition linkage: `SSMValid`; evaluated in `S2` before `FreshnessPass`.. Failure effect: `FAIL_CLOSED -> REJECT_INVALID`.
source_refs: Freshness Portability Agent — Specification §7 Validator Catalogue / VAL-002

entries.definition_short: Validates that the packet hash matches the transferred artifacts.
entries.definition_operational: Input: TransferPacket. Guard / transition linkage: `PacketHashValid`; evaluated in `S2` before `FreshnessPass`.. Failure effect: `FAIL_CLOSED -> REJECT_INVALID`.
source_refs: Freshness Portability Agent — Specification §7 Validator Catalogue / VAL-003

entries.definition_short: Validates `policy_id`, `policy_version`, and local profile compatibility.
entries.definition_operational: Input: `SSM` / policy snapshot. Guard / transition linkage: `PolicyCompatible`; fail `S2 -> S8` or `S2 -> S7` when recoverable.. Failure effect: `REJECT -> REJECT_INVALID` or `QUARANTINE -> OPEN_QUARANTINE_CASE`.
source_refs: Freshness Portability Agent — Specification §7 Validator Catalogue / VAL-004

entries.definition_short: Enforces `freshness_new > watermark[source_id]`.
entries.definition_operational: Input: Freshness value + watermark. Guard / transition linkage: `FreshnessPass`; pass `S2 -> S3`; fail `S2 -> S8`.. Failure effect: `REJECT -> REJECT_STALE`.
source_refs: Freshness Portability Agent — Specification §7 Validator Catalogue / VAL-005

entries.definition_short: Validates receipt anchoring and accepted-head linkage.
entries.definition_operational: Input: `IRR`. Guard / transition linkage: `IRRValid && linked_head`; allows `S5 -> S6`; failing restore path goes `S5 -> S8`.. Failure effect: `FAIL_CLOSED -> DENY_RESTORE`.
source_refs: Freshness Portability Agent — Specification §7 Validator Catalogue / VAL-006

entries.definition_short: Validates authenticated/encrypted transport when required by policy.
entries.definition_operational: Input: Transport metadata. Guard / transition linkage: `TransportPolicySatisfied`; fail `S2 -> S8` or `S2 -> S7` when recoverable.. Failure effect: `REJECT -> REJECT_INVALID` or `QUARANTINE -> OPEN_QUARANTINE_CASE`.
source_refs: Freshness Portability Agent — Specification §7 Validator Catalogue / VAL-007

entries.definition_short: Validates `TVC` when present and/or required.
entries.definition_operational: Input: `TVC`. Guard / transition linkage: `TVCValidWhenRequired`; fail `S2 -> S8` or `S2 -> S7` when recoverable.. Failure effect: `REJECT -> REJECT_INVALID` or `QUARANTINE -> OPEN_QUARANTINE_CASE`.
source_refs: Freshness Portability Agent — Specification §7 Validator Catalogue / VAL-008

entries.definition_short: Validates `Evidence.bin`, including signature, hash binding, evidence sequence, and validity window.
entries.definition_operational: Input: `Evidence.bin`. Guard / transition linkage: `EvidenceValidWhenRequired`; fail `S2 -> S8` or `S2 -> S7` when recoverable.. Failure effect: `REJECT -> REJECT_INVALID` or `QUARANTINE -> OPEN_QUARANTINE_CASE`.
source_refs: Freshness Portability Agent — Specification §7 Validator Catalogue / VAL-009

entries.definition_short: Validates the `GenesisConfirmed` precondition before restore eligibility is granted.
entries.definition_operational: Input: Restore context. Guard / transition linkage: `GenesisConfirmed`; allows `S5 -> S6`; fail `S5 -> S8`.. Failure effect: `FAIL_CLOSED -> DENY_RESTORE`.
source_refs: Freshness Portability Agent — Specification §7 Validator Catalogue / VAL-010

entries.definition_short: Ensures that freshness acceptance does not authorize tool-state activation.
entries.definition_operational: Input: Tool manifest / restore plan. Guard / transition linkage: `ToolStateActivationRequested == false` within agent authority; violation routes `S5/S6 -> S7` or `S8`.. Failure effect: `QUARANTINE -> OPEN_QUARANTINE_CASE` or `FAIL_CLOSED -> BLOCK_TOOL_STATE`.
source_refs: Freshness Portability Agent — Specification §7 Validator Catalogue / VAL-011

entries.definition_short: Boundary component separating operator review from automated gate behavior.

entries.definition_short: Boundary component representing the applied local policy context.

entries.definition_short: Boundary component that holds the append-only acceptance receipt path.
entries.definition_operational: The receipt journal receives durable receipt append operations and supports receipt anchoring, accepted-head linkage, and restore eligibility.
source_refs: Freshness Portability Agent — Specification §2 Agent Overview

entries.definition_short: The locally committed freshness reference for a source.
entries.definition_operational: The watermark may move only forward and only after durable receipt anchoring. It is the stored reference used by freshness comparison and restore control.
source_refs: Freshness Portability Agent — Specification §3 Core Terms and Public Definitions

entries.definition_short: A restore precondition indicating that the required baseline state has already been established or verified.
entries.definition_operational: Restore eligibility is not granted unless this precondition is satisfied. Missing GenesisConfirmed blocks restore admission.
source_refs: Freshness Portability Agent — Specification §3 Core Terms and Public Definitions

entries.definition_short: Finite authority budget under which the watermark may move only forward and only one semantic verdict may be emitted per packet-hash/freshness tuple.
entries.definition_operational: The authority budget prohibits retroactive downgrade, watermark decrement, rewrite, or authority expansion into non-authority zones.
source_refs: Freshness Portability Agent — Specification §5 Agent Authority Record

entries.definition_short: Mandatory semantic ordering declared as validate -> append IRR -> persist watermark -> update indexes.
entries.definition_operational: This sequence fixes the order of effective acceptance and prevents watermark advancement before durable receipt append.
source_refs: Freshness Portability Agent — Specification §15 Temporal and Ordering Contract

entries.definition_short: For each decision object, exactly one normative path may remain active after evaluating the full condition set.
entries.definition_operational: The rule closes the decision space and prevents multiple concurrent normative outcomes for the same evaluated decision object.
source_refs: Freshness Portability Agent — Specification §13 Gate Logic

entries.definition_short: Blocked effect for invalid, incomplete, or unauthorized conditions.
entries.definition_operational: Fail-closed behavior applies to structural, hash, signature, freshness, policy, evidence, transport, restore, and tool-state failures as specified by the failure semantics.
source_refs: Freshness Portability Agent — Specification §1 Normative Status and Scope
Freshness Portability Agent — Specification §16 Failure Semantics

entries.definition_short: Strictly increasing freshness ordering per source_id.
entries.definition_operational: Freshness monotonicity is the ordering root for acceptance and is enforced through the freshness rule and receipt-linked watermark advancement.
source_refs: Freshness Portability Agent — Specification §15 Temporal and Ordering Contract

entries.definition_short: No acceptance verdict becomes effective without durable IRR append.
entries.definition_operational: The rule binds effective acceptance to receipt anchoring and prevents acceptance without durable receipt append.
source_refs: Freshness Portability Agent — Specification §13 Gate Logic

entries.definition_short: No restoration eligibility exists without valid IRR linkage and GenesisConfirmed.
entries.definition_operational: The rule blocks restore admission unless receipt anchoring and the baseline precondition are both satisfied.
source_refs: Freshness Portability Agent — Specification §13 Gate Logic

entries.definition_short: No watermark advances before receipt append, and no accepted watermark may be decremented.
entries.definition_operational: The rule makes watermark progression monotonic and receipt-dependent.
source_refs: Freshness Portability Agent — Specification §13 Gate Logic

entries.definition_short: Implementation recovery checkpoints used to prove idempotence across interrupted acceptance sequences.
entries.definition_operational: The classes structure crash recovery and demonstrate idempotent recovery without degrading the accepted watermark.
source_refs: Freshness Portability Agent — Specification §3 Core Terms and Public Definitions

entries.definition_short: An optional external evidence artifact that becomes mandatory only when required by local policy.
entries.definition_operational: The artifact is optional by default, but when active policy requires it, missing or invalid evidence produces fail-closed rejection or quarantine depending on recoverability and policy.
source_refs: Freshness Portability Agent — Specification §3 Core Terms and Public Definitions

entries.definition_short: The append-only acceptance receipt used to anchor accepted imports and to gate downstream restoration eligibility.

entries.definition_short: A signed metadata artifact used for source binding and packet-hash binding during acceptance evaluation.
entries.definition_operational: The artifact is validated during acceptance and participates in source binding, policy compatibility, and packet-hash binding.
source_refs: Freshness Portability Agent — Specification §3 Core Terms and Public Definitions

entries.definition_short: An optional validation artifact that becomes mandatory only when required by local policy.
entries.definition_operational: The artifact is optional by default and is validated when present and/or required. Missing or invalid required TVC prevents successful acceptance.
